taxes.tax: Ritenute alla fonte su redditi corrisposti a non residenti (dividend, interest, services)
taxes.statute: Legge 16 dicembre 2013 n.166 art. 5, 102, 103 [year in force 2025 (pass 18), unchanged-confirmed: testo coordinato with notes (12.12.2025): art. 148 c. 8 states the wording of art. 102 and 103 applying until 31.12.2025: art. 102 c. 1 20 %, c. 2 3 %; art. 103 c. 1 13 %, c. 6 5 % on profits paid to individuals and none to others, as modelled; art. 5 as amended by L. 141/2025 art. 2 applies from 2026 (art. 54 c. 1-2)]
taxes.dated: testo coordinato con note (12.12.2025), art. 148 c. 8 (2025 wording of art. 102-103); L. 141/2025 art. 54 c. 1-2
unsupported: services are taken as self-employed or assimilated services (art. 27); the 3 % rate for listed services is not applied
interest is taken as paid by a non-financial company (art. 103 c. 1); bank interest follows c. 2
treaty rates and EU directives out of scope (statutory, treaty-free)
